global.title: France to send soldiers to Saudi Arabia to help secure energy sites
global.summary: France plans to deploy soldiers to Saudi Arabia as attacks by Yemen’s Houthi militia add pressure to Red Sea cities and global oil supplies.
global.whyItMatters: Energy insecurity and regional conflict can quickly affect household stress, prices, and prayer needs in your congregation.

global.title: Russia wages ‘total war’ on Ukraine’s economy
global.summary: A New York Times world roundup reports Russia is increasingly targeting Ukraine’s economy, with strikes disrupting work, logistics, and daily life far beyond the front lines.
global.whyItMatters: This is a reminder to pray not only for peace but for civilians, churches, and families enduring long-term exhaustion and loss.

global.title: Zelenskyy warns AI could soon shape the battlefield
global.summary: Just Security reports Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned at the U.N. that Russia’s war could spread and that AI may soon play a decisive role in combat decisions.
global.whyItMatters: It raises moral questions about technology, human dignity, and peacemaking that pastors may need to help people think through biblically.

canadian.title: Canada’s purchase of American cars hits new low as tariffs bite
canadian.summary: Fortune reports Canadian purchases of U.S.-made vehicles have fallen sharply as the tariff fight deepens, with more pressure expected when broader levies expand in January.
canadian.whyItMatters: Trade strain affects jobs, affordability, and economic anxiety for Canadian families your church may be serving.

canadian.title: Canada’s top diplomat promotes a ‘middle powers strategy’ at the U.N.
canadian.summary: At the U.N. General Assembly, Canada’s foreign minister said the country is leaning into a larger role among ‘middle powers’ in global diplomacy.
canadian.whyItMatters: Canada’s international posture shapes how the nation speaks about peace, justice, and moral leadership on the world stage.

canadian.title: Road World Championships spotlight Canada in Montréal
canadian.summary: The Road World Championships schedule highlights Montréal-hosted events this weekend, including Canadian rider Sarah van Dam in the elite women’s race.
canadian.whyItMatters: It is a lighter national story that offers a shared point of encouragement and civic pride amid heavier headlines.

local.title: Fraser Valley communities prepare fresh Truth and Reconciliation events
local.summary: New local details highlight several upcoming Fraser Valley gatherings for the National Day for Truth and Reconciliation, including workshops, cultural sharing, and community learning in Chilliwack and Abbotsford.
local.whyItMatters: This gives practical opportunities for pastoral presence, listening, and thoughtful congregational engagement.

local.title: M2W2 marks 60 years of mentoring people impacted by incarceration
local.summary: Abbotsford-based M2W2 is preparing a 60th anniversary gala while highlighting its recent work in prison mentorship, reintegration support, and work experience for former inmates.
local.whyItMatters: It points to a meaningful local ministry partnership area around restoration, justice, and second chances.

local.title: Langley Secondary opens new wing with 300 more student spaces
local.summary: A new addition at Langley Secondary has opened, adding classrooms, a science lab, special-education spaces, and upgraded air systems.
local.whyItMatters: Growing school capacity signals where young families are gathering and where churches may need to pay attention to student and parent needs.

persecutedChurch.title: Nigerian pastor and believer killed on their way to church
persecutedChurch.summary: International Christian Concern reports a pastor and another Christian were killed while traveling to church in Nigeria amid a wider surge of killings and kidnappings.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: This is a direct call to prayer for courage, protection, and solidarity with believers facing deadly violence for their faith.

persecutedChurch.title: Iranian Christian refugees face ‘year zero’ in U.S. admissions
persecutedChurch.summary: AsiaNews says no Iranian Christian refugees have been admitted to the United States this year, leaving many persecuted believers with fewer safe options.
persecutedChurch.whyItMatters: It highlights the vulnerability of displaced Christians and may inform prayer, advocacy, and refugee-minded ministry.

leadership.title: Sustainable leadership requires alignment, capacity, and collaboration
leadership.summary: A nonprofit leadership post argues sustainability is not asking committed people to endure more, but building healthier systems and shared capacity for the work.
leadership.whyItMatters: A helpful reminder for church leadership: long-term ministry health depends on structure and teamwork, not just sacrifice.

goodNews.title: Teenager captured on CCTV stopping runaway car with elderly passengers inside
goodNews.summary: BBC uplifting coverage highlights a teenager who intervened to stop a runaway car, protecting elderly passengers from harm.
goodNews.whyItMatters: It is a simple picture of courage and neighbour-love that can encourage a congregation weary of darker news.
